# Gramlot 0.3.3 — Create index entries on demand

- Let container-based index pages create a selected entry through an asynchronous Source callback instead of prebuilding every panel.
- Deduplicate concurrent selections, keep the latest requested selection active and retain already opened panels and their Data. Loading feedback and retry are available to the owning application.
- Preserve the existing eager index path and keep gallery-specific fragments in gramlot-examples. No Source activation or dependency contract changes.

Qualified with independent core tests, the full JavaScript suite and both gallery candidates in Chromium/WebKit. Publication repeats the required Python, JavaScript and Inspector CI checks.
